#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>

#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>

#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat16(GLfloat m0, GLfloat m1, GLfloat m2, GLfloat m3,
                   GLfloat m4, GLfloat m5, GLfloat m6, GLfloat m7,
                   GLfloat m8, GLfloat m9, GLfloat m10, GLfloat m11,
                   GLfloat m12, GLfloat m13, GLfloat m14, GLfloat m15) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat16_buf[16];
  repl_glfloat16_buf[0] = m0;   repl_glfloat16_buf[1] = m1;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[2] = m2;   repl_glfloat16_buf[3] = m3;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[4] = m4;   repl_glfloat16_buf[5] = m5;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[6] = m6;   repl_glfloat16_buf[7] = m7;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[8] = m8;   repl_glfloat16_buf[9] = m9;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[10] = m10; repl_glfloat16_buf[11] = m11;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[12] = m12; repl_glfloat16_buf[13] = m13;
  repl_glfloat16_buf[14] = m14; repl_glfloat16_buf[15] = m15;
  return repl_glfloat16_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
  // Eye-space light positions, set before the camera transform.
  glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, repl_glfloat4(0, 0, -1, 1));
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -7.9000f);
  glRotatef(24.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(-28.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -1.1500f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---

  static float lx, ly, lz; // orbiting lamp position, read by the matrix and the marker

  // The caster, drawn twice: once squashed by the shadow matrix, once for
  // real. One definition means the two can never drift apart.
  caster() {
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0, 1.05, 0);
      glRotatef(26*t, 0, 1, 0);
      glutSolidTeapot(0.62);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // Translate, rotate and scale cannot flatten a solid onto a plane -- that
  // takes a matrix of their own. glMultMatrixf posts one onto the modelview
  // stack: 16 column-major cells, either inline as below or read from a
  // scratch array with glMultMatrixf(A).
  //
  // These cells are the classic planar shadow projection for the ground
  // plane y = 0 and a point light at (lx, ly, lz). It maps every point to
  // where the ray from the lamp through it crosses the floor, so drawing
  // the SAME geometry under it draws the object's shadow. Cells are
  // ordinary expressions, re-evaluated every frame, so moving the lamp
  // moves the shadow -- no rebuild of the caster.

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

  lx = 2.4*cos(0.5*t);
  ly = 3.4;
  lz = 2.4*sin(0.5*t);

  // Floor first, so the shadow has something to land on.
  glColor3f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98);
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    glNormal3f(0, 1, 0);
    glVertex3f(-3.5, 0, -3.5);
    glVertex3f(-3.5, 0, 3.5);
    glVertex3f(3.5, 0, 3.5);
    glVertex3f(3.5, 0, -3.5);
  glEnd();

  // Shadow pass. The projection is singular -- it collapses y to 0 -- so
  // the result lands exactly on the floor and would z-fight it. Painting
  // with the depth test off and depth writes masked settles that: the
  // shadow covers the floor it follows, and the lit pass below still
  // draws over the shadow.
  glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.05, 0.06, 0.08);
  glPushMatrix();
    glMultMatrixf((GLfloat[]){ly, 0, 0, 0, -lx, 0, -lz, -1, 0, 0, ly, 0, 0, 0, 0, ly});
    caster();
  glPopMatrix();
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);

  // The caster itself, in the frame the shadow was cast from.
  glColor3f(1, 0.35, 0.2);
  caster();

  // The lamp, so the sweep of the shadow reads as a light moving.
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(1, 0.85, 0.15);
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(lx, ly, lz);
    glutSolidSphere(0.13, 12, 10);
  glPopMatrix();
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
